licence.name: licencia de conducir no profesional (tipo B)

note: Read 2026-10-30. The ANT's own sites (ant.gob.ec, gob.ec) didn't answer from here, so this rests on Expreso's reports quoting the ANT (secondary). The 2026 tariff, approved in January 2026 by resolution 001-DIR-2026-ANT and in force from March 2026 (Expreso, 7 March 2026), sets the first issue of a non-professional licence (types A, B and F) at USD 68; Expreso of 11 May 2026 gives the ANT's 2026 values as $68 for types A and B (non-professional) and the requirement of being 18 to get a licence for the first time (with a learner's permit and a non-professional driver's title from a driving school, not held); Expreso of 7 November 2025 reports the ANT saying the type B licence is renewed every 5 years, so its term is held as 5 years. The psychosensometric test (about $20) and the driving course aren't the licence's fee and aren't held. In March 2026 the ANT said issuing and renewal weren't yet open and extended the validity of expired licences; that isn't held. No exchange list or identity card was read.

sources.title: Expreso, Licencia de conducir en Ecuador 2026: requisitos, costo (11 May 2026)
sources.said: Para acceder a una licencia de conducir en Ecuador en 2026, los aspirantes deben cumplir con varios requisitos: Tener 18 años cumplidos. ... De acuerdo con la Agencia Nacional de Tránsito (ANT), los valores vigentes en 2026 son los siguientes: Licencias profesionales: $110. Licencias tipo A y B (no profesionales): $68.
